description: Runs the backlog with N background Claude sessions in parallel, one card each in its own git worktree, integrating into one control branch: a detached supervisor recycles each session between cards, an atomic per-card claim keeps two sessions off one card, and the review ends by merging into the control branch and pushing without ever forcing.

tools.name: autoloop
tools.description: Starts, inspects and stops the parallel loop, and gives its workers card claims, card branches and the integration into the control branch.
